stations.name: Port Townsend
stations.note: Stage 1 start, Point Hudson.

stations.name: Point Wilson
stations.note: First gate of Stage 1. Strong ebb out of Admiralty Inlet helps at the 05:00 start; a flood here means fighting to clear the point.

stations.name: Strait of Juan de Fuca (south of Discovery Is.)
stations.note: Mid-strait set while crossing the shipping lanes.

stations.name: Juan de Fuca - East
stations.note: Ebb and wind against it produce the steep seas the baseline warns about.

stations.name: Race Passage
stations.note: West of the Victoria finish. Matters if you get set west on the crossing.

stations.name: Trial Island
stations.note: Approach to the Ogden Point finish and the first mile of Stage 2. Tide rips off Trial Island.

stations.name: Victoria Harbour
stations.note: Stage 1 finish and Stage 2 start.

stations.name: South Haro Strait
stations.note: Northbound you want the flood. The ebb runs hard south past Sidney.

stations.name: Turn Point (Boundary Pass)
stations.note: Boundary Pass into the Strait of Georgia. Big overfalls on the ebb against a NW breeze.

stations.name: Active Pass
stations.note: Alternative inside route through the Gulf Islands. Ferry traffic.

stations.name: Porlier Pass
stations.note: Alternative inside route exit to the Strait of Georgia.

stations.name: Point Atkinson
stations.note: Reference tide for the Strait of Georgia.

stations.name: Campbell River
stations.note: Last town before Seymour Narrows.

stations.name: Seymour Narrows
stations.note: Mandatory waypoint. Up to ~15 kn on big tides with whirlpools. Northbound boats need the ebb (north-going) or slack; plan to arrive at slack before ebb.

stations.name: Johnstone Strait - Central
stations.note: Westerly afternoon sea breeze against the flood builds steep chop. Ebb sets west (favourable).

stations.name: Blackney Passage
stations.note: Shortcut north of Hanson Island into Blackfish Sound.

stations.name: Weynton Passage
stations.note: Exit from Johnstone Strait to Queen Charlotte Strait. Ebb runs NW with you.

stations.name: Alert Bay
stations.note: Broughton Strait.

stations.name: Port Hardy
stations.note: Last stop before Cape Caution and Queen Charlotte Sound.

stations.name: Bella Bella
stations.note: Mandatory waypoint: cross the line between the Bella Bella dock and the Old Bella Bella dock.

stations.name: Hiekish Narrows
stations.note: Inside route only: Finlayson Channel to Graham Reach.

stations.name: Hartley Bay
stations.note: Inside route, Wright Sound.

stations.name: Grenville Channel (narrow portion)
stations.note: Inside route only. Floods meet near the narrow portion, so the current reverses partway along the channel.

stations.name: Prince Rupert
stations.note: Chatham Sound. Reference tide for the northern BC coast.

stations.name: Tongass Narrows (Ketchikan)
stations.note: Final approach to Thomas Basin.

stations.name: Ketchikan
stations.note: Finish at Thomas Basin. Local clocks are Alaska time (PDT minus 1 h).
